title: Laser removal of spider veins on the face
what: A laser heats the widened blood vessels on the face, and they slowly disappear. The skin around them is not damaged.
why: For spider veins and fine red lines on the nose, cheeks, and chin.
duration: a session usually takes 15 to 30 minutes; several sessions are often needed
tell_doctor: Whether you have been in the sun recently
If you have had cold sores or thick raised scars (keloids)
All medicines, especially those that make you sensitive to sun or thin your blood

prepare.title: Sun
prepare.text: Usually no sunbathing for 2 to 4 weeks before the procedure. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Products
prepare.text: If you use strong skin creams, tell your doctor, as you may be asked to stop them.

steps: You and the doctor put on protective glasses
A cooling gel is applied or cooling is turned on
The doctor treats the vessels with short flashes
Your skin is cooled and a soothing product is applied
feel: The flashes feel like a rubber band snapping
Afterward, redness and slight swelling, sometimes temporary small bruises
after: The redness usually goes away in a few days
A few days with no bath, sauna, or hot shower
The next session is usually after a few weeks
red_flags: Blisters, crusts, or severe pain: see a doctor
Dark or light patches on the skin after a few weeks: show them to your doctor

faq.a: Treated vessels usually do not return. But new ones can appear over time.

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: Often right away or after a few weeks. Sometimes repeat sessions are needed.

reminders.text: Laser for facial veins tomorrow. Come without makeup and bring sunscreen.
